meta.parties: Attorney General v. Ramaswamy Iyengar, V

rules.statement: A deceased 'co-parcener' under Mitakshara law is not 'competent to dispose' of a fractional share in the joint property until an intention to separate and its communication have occurred, and such competency must exist at the moment immediately preceding death.
rules.supporting_quote: "I concede that, upon the communication of his unilateral decision to separate himself in status and title from the undivided family, a 'co-parcener' immediately becomes 'competent to dispose' of the definite share which he thus acquires for the first time. A. I. R. 1916 P. C. 104"
